How knowledge compounds

Confidence grows.
Gaps close.

Every research run adds to the same topic. SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) rises as contested claims are resolved. Breadth expands as gaps are filled. The brief at run five is built on everything learned in runs one through four.

Run Research Further to target only contested claims and known gaps — not the whole topic again. Knowledge accumulates without resetting.

The problem

Every AI tool gives you answers.
None tell you which ones to trust.

01 / Confidence
Stated confidence is theatre
LLM self-reported confidence bears no relationship to actual accuracy. A tool that says 90% confident may be right 24% of the time. Every summary tool hides this.
Distilapp computes confidence from evidence: source tier, provider consensus, Socratic challenge survival, recency decay.
02 / Memory
Every session starts from zero
There is no accumulation, no graph linking what you've learned, no way to ask what you already know. Research evaporates. Institutional knowledge does not compound.
Distilapp's knowledge graph grows with every session — fully private, bounded, entirely on your machine.
03 / Accountability
No audit trail is now a liability
The EU AI Act entered full enforcement in 2026. High-risk AI use requires documented evidence of what your system knew and how confident it was. No other tool provides this.
Distilapp's Decision Log records the complete evidence state at every decision — immutably.
Claims intelligence

Not summaries. Evidence.

Every finding is a structured claim — scored, sourced, traceable. The weak claim at 29% is as important as the verified claim at 90%. Both are shown. Neither is hidden.

Governance

Responsible AI isn't a checkbox.
It's an architecture decision.

Built ground-up with the human governance layer that almost every AI tool skips. Not added as a feature — embedded in the pipeline from the first sprint.

📋
Decision Log
When you act on research, log the decision. Distilapp captures the full evidence state at that moment — immutably, timestamped, exportable. The record the EU AI Act now requires.
🔒
Zero data egress
Knowledge graph, source documents, research — all local. AI providers process queries; they never see your accumulated intelligence. Bring your own API keys.
⚖️
Abstain rather than confabulate
Before synthesis, the pipeline checks evidence sufficiency. If the base is too thin, it tells you why — rather than producing confident-sounding output on weak foundations.
🎯
Confidence you can defend
Every confidence score is computed from source tier, provider consensus, Socratic challenge, and recency decay — never from what the model asserts about its own certainty.
